headline: Buyers turn to ARMs
at a *record pace*
slides.fig_caption: Share of October rate locks that were adjustable-rate loans
slides.sub: The highest ARM share in Optimal Blue data since 2019, as buyers work around 7% rates.

slides.title: ARM share of *rate locks*
slides.note: Each of the last two months set a new high for the data series.

slides.label: total rate-lock volume, *year over year*
slides.body: Locks fell 19% from September. Purchase locks dropped 18% on the month and 17% on the year, even as the 30-year conforming rate eased to 7.15%.

slides.title: Getting *creative* to close
points: FHA loans: 20% of all locks, up from a year ago
One lender: about 75% of her clients get seller concessions
Average locked loan amount: $384,000, down 3% on the month

slides.title: Sell the *payment*
slides.body: Buyers are stacking ARMs, buydowns and seller credits to make monthly costs work. Partner with a lender who can model each option, and prep sellers early for concession asks.
